user.title: Tuya Cloud project
user.description: The Access ID and Access Secret of your Cloud Development project on iot.tuya.com. The project must be subscribed to the Smart Lock Open Service.

locks.title: Which locks
locks.description: Pick the locks to manage. Locks are pre-selected; other devices are listed only when the account has no lock in a category we recognise.

error.invalid_auth: Tuya refused the credentials. Check the Access ID, the Access Secret and the data centre.
error.no_devices: This project lists no devices. Link your Tuya app account to the project on iot.tuya.com.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong; see the log.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya project is already set up.

data_description.refresh_minutes: Every refresh is a handful of calls per lock against your Tuya project's monthly allowance.

unlock.name: Open the door
unlock.description: Opens the door of a lock.

create_code.name: Create a temporary code
create_code.description: Creates a temporary code with a PIN of your own. Answers with the code id.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock to put the code on.

password.name: PIN
password.description: Digits only. Most keypads expect six.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the code list and the unlock log.

one_time.name: Single use
one_time.description: The code expires after one use.

days.name: Days
days.description: For a recurring daily pattern: the weekdays it applies to.

book.name: Create a booking code
book.description: A code per booking: the two-digit year of check-in plus the last four digits of the guest's phone number. Answers with the code id.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock to put the code on.

revoke_code.name: Revoke a code
revoke_code.description: The code stops working. Its record stays in the list until purged.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock the code is on.

code_id.name: Code id
code_id.description: As returned when the code was created, or from the code list.

purge_code.name: Purge a code record
purge_code.description: Removes an expired or revoked code from the list.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock the code is on.

code_id.name: Code id
code_id.description: As returned when the code was created, or from the code list.

list_codes.name: List codes
list_codes.description: Every temporary code on a lock, as Tuya reports it.

add_profile.name: Add a profile
add_profile.description: Creates a profile with a permanent PIN. Answers with its user id.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock to add the profile to.

name.name: Name
name.description: The profile's name; also used for the PIN in the unlock log.

delete_profile.name: Delete a profile
delete_profile.description: Removes a profile and all its codes and cards.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock the profile is on.

user_id.name: Profile id
user_id.description: From the profile's switch attributes or the profile list.

add_method.name: Add a code or card to a profile
add_method.description: A PIN is added straight away. For a card the lock goes into enrolment mode: hold the card against the keypad within a minute.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock the profile is on.

user_id.name: Profile id
user_id.description: From the profile's switch attributes or the profile list.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the unlock log. Defaults to the profile's name.

rename_method.name: Rename a code or card
rename_method.description: Gives a code or card a name of your own.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock the profile is on.

user_id.name: Profile id
user_id.description: The profile the method belongs to.

sn.name: Slot
sn.description: The method's slot number, from the profile's switch attributes.

delete_method.name: Remove a code or card
delete_method.description: Removes one code or card from a profile.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: The lock the profile is on.

user_id.name: Profile id
user_id.description: The profile the method belongs to.

sn.name: Slot
sn.description: The method's slot number, from the profile's switch attributes.

list_profiles.name: List profiles
list_profiles.description: Every member of a lock with its permanent codes and cards, including app accounts that share it.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the codes, the unlock log and the profiles now instead of at the next interval.

device_id.name: Lock
device_id.description: Any lock of the account; the whole account refreshes.
